items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: stayed with Uncle John who had 3 daughters... A son named John Albert Coleman after his father... we used to have some swell times with Ida playing the piano and me singing. Uncle John had brought John, Jr. a C melody saxophone

ctx.x: Dad started to get suspicious when after a certain time his bank was not full. He found out what was happening and knew that it was me that was robbing him. My father never had to whip me, but this time he tied my hands with a rope and gave me the worse whipping I ever had. That was to teach me to never steal, especially from him.

That summer I went to Centerville for a vacation and stayed with Uncle John who had 3 daughters, Matty, Ida and Cora, A son named John Albert Coleman after his father. Matty and Ida were older than John and I. Ida played the Piano and was the organist at the Baptist church. For playing hymns, Ida was alright but when she played sheet music (popular songs) she would not give the measures their proper value. She could read very well but in some places, she just didn't have rhythm. Nevertheless, we used to have some…
